periods.time: EDY breach of Tokyo's underground defense layer
periods.label: 病后重返战场的最后武士

status.condition: recently discharged but still skilled enough to cut EDY joints

relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Daughter; joins the fight and kicks her out of the line of fire at his own risk.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Former dojo usurper whose later arrival saves Kaito and Ayase from EDY.

periods.summary: Kaito appears in the underground defense layer with a real sword despite being a non-Blazer and recently hospitalized. He corrects Ayase's tense sword form, uses Ayatsuji Ittou-ryuu technique to cut EDY units through their softer joints, and fights beside the students. When Ayase is injured and targeted by a hadron shot, Kaito kicks her away and exposes himself, only to be saved when Kuraudo arrives and destroys the EDY.

key_events.summary: Cuts EDY joints and saves Ayase before Kuraudo and the returning knights arrive.
